text.en:
The Director of the National Library, subject to the approval of the Department Head, is
hereby-authorized to negotiate and consummate the purchase, from Professor Austin Craig or from his heirs,
assigns or successors, of the copyright in the book "Rizal's Own Story of His Life" which was edited by him,
the purchase to include Professor Craig's present collection of Philippine materials consisting of papers and
documents on the Islands, as well as his unpublished writings and studies about the Philippines, all of which
shall be preserved and administered by the National Library in accordance with section sixteen hundred and
ninety-four of the Administrative Code.

To carry out the purposes of this Act, the sum of fifteen thousand pesos or so much thereof as
shall be necessary, is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise
appropriated.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, November 30, 1936.
